items.title: Create sandbox root marker file
items.description:
Work only under `sandbox/ralph-series/`.

Create the directory `sandbox/ralph-series` if it does not exist and create `sandbox/ralph-series/README.txt` with a short note that this folder is used for Ralph Loop soak testing.

Requirements:
- Only modify files under `sandbox/ralph-series/`.
- Do not change repo code/config/docs outside the sandbox.

Acceptance criteria:
- `sandbox/ralph-series/README.txt` exists.
- File contains at least 2 human-readable lines.

items.title: Create alpha note file
items.description:
Work only under `sandbox/ralph-series/`.

Create `sandbox/ralph-series/alpha.txt` with 3 short lines of text.

Requirements:
- Overwrite the file if it already exists.
- Keep content plain text (ASCII only).

Acceptance criteria:
- `sandbox/ralph-series/alpha.txt` exists.
- File has exactly 3 lines.

items.title: Create beta note file
items.description:
Work only under `sandbox/ralph-series/`.

Create `sandbox/ralph-series/beta.txt` with 2 short lines of text.

Acceptance criteria:
- `sandbox/ralph-series/beta.txt` exists.
- File has exactly 2 lines.

items.title: Append timestamp line to alpha
items.description:
Work only under `sandbox/ralph-series/`.

Append one new line to `alpha.txt` that starts with `updated:`.

Requirements:
- Preserve existing content in `alpha.txt`.
- If `alpha.txt` is missing, fail by creating a clear change that depends on `task-202` (this task already depends on it).

Acceptance criteria:
- `alpha.txt` contains one appended line beginning with `updated:`.

items.title: Create gamma from alpha and beta summary
items.description:
Work only under `sandbox/ralph-series/`.

Create `gamma.txt` summarizing `alpha.txt` and `beta.txt` (for example, file names and line counts).

Requirements:
- Read both source files.
- Produce a deterministic text format.

Acceptance criteria:
- `sandbox/ralph-series/gamma.txt` exists.
- It mentions both `alpha.txt` and `beta.txt`.

items.title: Create nested docs folder and note
items.description:
Work only under `sandbox/ralph-series/`.

Create `sandbox/ralph-series/docs/note-206.txt` with a short message.

Acceptance criteria:
- Nested folder `docs` exists.
- `note-206.txt` exists in that folder.

items.title: Create docs index listing
items.description:
Work only under `sandbox/ralph-series/`.

Create `sandbox/ralph-series/docs/index.txt` that lists files currently in `sandbox/ralph-series/docs/`.

Requirements:
- Include `note-206.txt` in the index.

Acceptance criteria:
- `docs/index.txt` exists.
- It references `note-206.txt`.

items.title: Create high-priority blocked task marker
items.description:
Work only under `sandbox/ralph-series/`.

Create `blocked-high.txt` with a line explaining it was intentionally blocked by dependencies during scheduling.

Acceptance criteria:
- `sandbox/ralph-series/blocked-high.txt` exists.

items.title: Create delta branch A file
items.description:
Work only under `sandbox/ralph-series/`.

Create `delta-a.txt` with a short line identifying branch A.

Acceptance criteria:
- `sandbox/ralph-series/delta-a.txt` exists.

items.title: Create delta branch B file
items.description:
Work only under `sandbox/ralph-series/`.

Create `delta-b.txt` with a short line identifying branch B.

Acceptance criteria:
- `sandbox/ralph-series/delta-b.txt` exists.

items.title: Create epsilon fan-in summary
items.description:
Work only under `sandbox/ralph-series/`.

Create `epsilon.txt` that combines or summarizes `delta-a.txt` and `delta-b.txt`.

Acceptance criteria:
- `sandbox/ralph-series/epsilon.txt` exists.
- It mentions both delta files.

items.title: Create independent low-priority scratch file
items.description:
Work only under `sandbox/ralph-series/`.

Create `scratch-212.txt` with one line of text. This task is intentionally independent and low priority.

Acceptance criteria:
- `sandbox/ralph-series/scratch-212.txt` exists.

items.title: Create zeta report from multiple roots
items.description:
Work only under `sandbox/ralph-series/`.

Create `zeta-report.txt` that references `README.txt`, `gamma.txt`, and `docs/index.txt`.

Acceptance criteria:
- `sandbox/ralph-series/zeta-report.txt` exists.
- It mentions all three source files.

items.title: Create copy of epsilon in exports folder
items.description:
Work only under `sandbox/ralph-series/`.

Create `sandbox/ralph-series/exports/epsilon-copy.txt` by copying or regenerating content from `epsilon.txt`.

Acceptance criteria:
- `sandbox/ralph-series/exports/epsilon-copy.txt` exists.

items.title: Create manifest of current sandbox files
items.description:
Work only under `sandbox/ralph-series/`.

Create `manifest.txt` listing the relative paths of `.txt` files currently present under `sandbox/ralph-series/`.

Requirements:
- Relative paths only.
- Deterministic order (sorted).

Acceptance criteria:
- `manifest.txt` exists.
- It includes at least `README.txt`, `alpha.txt`, and `beta.txt` once their dependencies are satisfied.

items.title: Create tie-priority item A
items.description:
Work only under `sandbox/ralph-series/`.

Create `tie-a.txt` with one line. This task shares the same priority as another task to exercise id tie-breaking.

Acceptance criteria:
- `sandbox/ralph-series/tie-a.txt` exists.

items.title: Create tie-priority item B
items.description:
Work only under `sandbox/ralph-series/`.

Create `tie-b.txt` with one line. Same priority as task-216 to exercise deterministic ordering by id.

Acceptance criteria:
- `sandbox/ralph-series/tie-b.txt` exists.

items.title: Create final aggregate from zeta, manifest, and export
items.description:
Work only under `sandbox/ralph-series/`.

Create `final-aggregate.txt` that summarizes `zeta-report.txt`, `manifest.txt`, and `exports/epsilon-copy.txt`.

Acceptance criteria:
- `sandbox/ralph-series/final-aggregate.txt` exists.
- It mentions all three inputs.

items.title: Create late fan-in verification note
items.description:
Work only under `sandbox/ralph-series/`.

Create `verify-219.txt` confirming completion of `final-aggregate.txt`, `tie-a.txt`, and `tie-b.txt` by referencing those file names.

Acceptance criteria:
- `sandbox/ralph-series/verify-219.txt` exists.
- It mentions `final-aggregate.txt`, `tie-a.txt`, and `tie-b.txt`.

items.title: Create completion stamp for soak run
items.description:
Work only under `sandbox/ralph-series/`.

Create `DONE-220.txt` as the final completion stamp for the synthetic Ralph soak backlog. Include a short summary of how many task files were generated (approximate count is acceptable if clearly labeled).

Acceptance criteria:
- `sandbox/ralph-series/DONE-220.txt` exists.
- It references the soak run/final completion.
